title: Card Wage Points on Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Transfers
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — card wage points for workers paid to a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account.**

Card wage points are added to the bank transfer percentage of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account:

- **10 points** when the worker holds a Paystride Visa Payroll Card Account whose status is active and at least **4** card loads with load source payroll posted to that account in the last two months;
- **5 points** when the worker holds an active account and one to three such loads posted to it in the last two months;
- **no points** otherwise.

The loads read are the card account's load entries whose load source is payroll and whose posted date falls in the last two months, on the worker's card account whose status is active. A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Card account | Payroll loads posted in the last two months | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| active | 4 or more | 10 |
| active | 1 to 3 | 5 |
| active | none | 0 |
| issued, blocked or closed, or no card held | any | 0 |

*Hypothetical:* a worker whose active card received three payroll loads in the last two months gains 5 points; a fourth such load lifts the points to 10. Loads of another source, such as an early wage transfer credited to the card, are not payroll loads and do not count.
